title: Broadway Oyster Bar
venue_description: Award-winning Cajun and Creole restaurant, bar, and live music venue operating since the 1970s. Widely regarded as the premier New Orleans-style music venue in the Midwest. Features live music twice daily seven nights a week across blues, rock, reggae, funk, R&B, and jam genres. Home to the longest-running blues jam session in the nation on Monday nights. Historic 1840s building with two covered heated outdoor patios.

title: Venice Cafe
venue_description: Iconic mosaic-covered cash-only art bar in the Benton Park neighborhood, open since 1988. A living art installation and live music venue rolled into one, featuring nightly music Monday through Saturday. Monday open mic is the longest-running of its kind in St. Louis. Known for eclectic decor including skulls, folk art, tile mosaics, outdoor patio with turtle pond, and an anything-goes artistic spirit.

title: Robbie's House of Jazz
venue_description: Community-focused jazz club in the heart of Old Webster Groves, opened in 2009 by Robert and Dorothy Edwards. Named for Dorothy's mother, Robbie, the club carries forward the jazz legacy of St. Louis's historic club scene. Features Tuesday open jazz jams, weekend performances by local and regional acts, and a commitment to jazz education and youth outreach.

title: Legacy Books and Cafe
venue_description: Independent bookstore and café on Delmar Boulevard, home venue for the WORDUP! Open Mic – St. Louis's premiere weekly arts showcase. Provides a community-centered space where literature, music, poetry, and comedy intersect. Welcoming and accessible environment with tiered seating for performers and audiences.

title: Pop's Blue Moon
venue_description: Intimate art bar and live music venue nestled in St. Louis's historic Hill neighborhood since 1999. Hosts live music six nights a week (Tue-Sat) with Tuesday open mics featuring acoustic early sets and electric jams with a house band. Known for its eclectic community vibe, lava lamps, cheap drinks, and the famous Terrapin Tuesdays pizza nights.

title: 1860s Hardshell Cafe
venue_description: A Soulard neighborhood fixture with deep roots in the St. Louis blues tradition. The venue hosts Jimmy Lee's weekly Wednesday blues jam, drawing both neighborhood regulars and traveling musicians to one of the city's most authentic blues spaces. Full bar and American kitchen.
